title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

judge.summary: The image is converted to neutral black and white with the car, background, and full original composition preserved.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car and all surrounding elements appear in neutral grayscale, with no visible residual colour.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The hatchback's position, silhouette, wheels, windows, lights, trim, and reflections match the original apart from colour.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: The houses, trees, parked cars, utility poles, road details, and shadows remain unchanged in placement and appearance.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in the photo's own shape.
must_haves.why: The output retains the original landscape proportions and the same visible content at all four edges.
